exam_scheme.note: Kerala Law Entrance Examination (KLEE) is conducted as a Computer Based Test (CBT) by the Commissioner for Entrance Examinations (CEE), Government of Kerala for admission to 3-Year LL.B. and Integrated 5-Year LL.B. programmes in Government and Private Self-Financing Law Colleges in Kerala. The test comprises 120 objective questions across four sections for a total duration of 120 minutes (2 hours). Valuation awards 3 marks for each correct response, with 1 mark deducted for each incorrect response (total 360 marks). Qualifying cutoff is 10% of total marks (36 marks out of 360) for General/SEBC candidates and 5% of total marks (18 marks out of 360) for SC/ST candidates.

papers.paper_name: General Knowledge & Current Affairs (27 questions: History, Geography, Indian Polity, International Events)
Arithmetic and Mental Ability (15 questions: Numerical Reasoning, Data Interpretation, Logical Sequences)
Aptitude for Legal Studies (42 questions: Constitutional Law, Legal Propositions, Torts, Contracts, Crimes, Legal Maxims)
